resources.title: llama.cpp
resources.why: Engine for three recipes; llama-bench and llama-perplexity give the speed and KLD numbers.

resources.title: Strata
resources.why: Engine for models far larger than RAM plus VRAM; its install plan says what will sit where before you download.

resources.title: Kintsugi-27B bundle
resources.why: The llama.cpp fork with EXL3 trellis kernels, tiered K/V cache and the DFlash2 drafter.

resources.title: ik_llama.cpp
resources.why: A llama.cpp fork we compared against stock llama.cpp on Flint.

resources.title: inference-optimisation skill
resources.why: The tuning loop we follow: compute the ceiling, change one thing, A/B against controls, qualify before publishing.

resources.title: local-ai-registry
resources.why: A registry of tuned local-model recipes across hardware; where our Flint recipe was submitted.

resources.title: Hugging Face Hub API
resources.why: Trending surveys, file sizes and the sha256 of every file before download; no token needed for public repos.

resources.title: ggml-org GGUFs
resources.why: Reference quants with imatrix, made with the same converter the engine ships.

resources.title: Unsloth GGUFs
resources.why: Dynamic low-bit quants; the only Inkling files that fit a 12 GB card whole.

resources.title: bartowski GGUFs
resources.why: Wide quant ladders with published imatrix files.

resources.title: decision-index kit
resources.why: A scoring kit we used to show that cutting loop passes destroys quality.

resources.title: Jev Decision Index
resources.why: The published index to compare decision-index scores against.

resources.title: nvidia-smi dmon
resources.why: One-second VRAM, utilisation and PCIe telemetry during every benchmark run.

resources.title: CUDA graphs
resources.why: Background for the cudaGraphInstantiate out-of-memory failure that hits layouts loaded too close to the card's limit.

resources.title: opencode
resources.why: The coding agent the Flint recipe is tuned behind; its 11k-token system prompt is our cold-prefill test.

resources.title: scripts/bench.py
resources.why: Streaming prefill and decode tok/s plus a 1 s sampler of VRAM, RAM, page cache, CPU and disk reads.

resources.title: scripts/codeeval.py
resources.why: Eight Python tasks checked against asserts at temperature 0, against any OpenAI-compatible server.
